intro.name: The crisis
intro.text: A researcher has proposed a treatment that exists only in calculations and sketches. Nobody has ever performed it.

a1.text: It works; the village celebrates a major medical discovery.

a2.text: It relieves symptoms but does not cure the illness.

a3.text: The experiment fails and the patient dies.

a4.text: The patient recovers, but evidence suggests the treatment was irrelevant.

b1.text: A fatal flaw is discovered before anyone is harmed.

b2.text: The scholars devise a safer approach.

b3.text: The patient dies while the researchers are still deliberating.

b4.text: The scholars demonstrate that the original proposal cannot work.
